task.title: Sidecar packet retention and cleanup policy
task.summary_zh: support/sidecars/ 持續累積 packets 但缺退場機制。設計 retention/cleanup module：parent task done 後 N 天，sidecar packet 移至 support/sidecars/archived/，超過 M 天直接刪。獨立 module，可由 cron / chair-review 觸發。
acceptance: sidecar_cleanup.py exposes scan() classify(sidecar_path) and execute(plan dry_run) functions
classify identifies sidecar packets whose parent task is archived as done over 14 days ago
execute(dry_run=True) returns plan without filesystem changes
execute(dry_run=False) moves stale packets to support/sidecars/archived/ and deletes packets older than 60 days
test covers 3 ages: fresh stale-but-archivable beyond-deletion exit 0
task.next: Closeout finalized: task-scoped commit a33472f7; verified python3 -m pytest .orchestrator/test_sidecar_cleanup.py (3 passed).
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：sidecar_cleanup.py 完整實作 scan() / classify(sidecar_path) / execute(plan, dry_run) 三個 API；classify 以 archive_after_days=14 正確識別超過門檻的 packet；execute(dry_run=True) 直接回傳 plan 無 FS 寫入；execute(dry_run=False) 移動至 archived/ 並刪除超過 60 天的 packet；test 覆蓋 fresh / stale-but-archivable / beyond-deletion 三個 age 場景加 CLI dry-run exit 0；pytest -q 3/3 通過。
